verdicts.reason: A is a near-uniform shrink of the original. The attribution 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' and the SOLSTICE can label are too small to read at this size, and there is a lot of empty space at mid-left. It does keep the original line break, the tracking and the can's sun detail. B has the same shrunk layout and the same unreadable can label. Its attribution has very wide, over-spaced letters that drift from the original typography, and the can is smaller, with its sun motif barely visible. The rewrap of the quote is fine but gains little.
